title: Definitely recommend for friends and even people that live in Barcelona!!
text: I had such an amazing experience, I came to Barcelona before and I didn't know most of the places that they showed to me, very local, cozy and vibe places. Its a nice scape from touristic spots, also I loved the guides, they made me feel very welcome and I wished they had more guided tours so I could get to see through their eyes the city ❤️
author: beatrizlF5664TF

title: BEAUTIFUL EXPERIENCE
text:
An unexpected walk with young, kind and knowledgeable guides. The aperitif not to be missed. 
Experience that I will definitely repeat!
author: Luca S

title: Magical time at Montjuïc
text: We did not know that there was such a beautiful natural environment just outside the also beautiful city center. The very friendly guide showed us some beautiful pathroads with amazing views and he learned us a lot about the city and her possibilties. Highly recommended!
author: laurensd521

title: This was the highlight of our trip to Barcelona!
text: The trails offer stunning views, a peaceful escape from the city, and a mix of nature and history. We appreciated the guide who was very personable and knowledgeable, making the experience even more enjoyable.
author: 696miguelw

title: Awesome trip
text: A relief of the classic tours in the city, also feels like a more outdoor experience in a more nature environment. Was social because of the vermuth moments and the guide was very open to learn us more about Barcelona and everything it has to offer.  Vibes were great and views were beautiful.
author: 200derm
